observations.name: Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information
observations.justification: Recovered 202.95.11.173 (XOR key 0x61) by brute-forcing every possible single-byte XOR key against the binary and requiring a clean null-padded boundary around the match (not just a coincidental decode). A network address stored obfuscated like this is unusable to the malware until it reverses the same encoding at runtime -- direct evidence of Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information (T1140).

observations.name: Credentials from Password Stores
observations.justification: A file path referencing the MetaMask browser extension's fixed store ID was found in the binary. Checking for or targeting a specific cryptocurrency wallet extension's installation path is characteristic of Credentials from Password Stores (T1555) -- these extension IDs are assigned once by the browser's extension store and have no legitimate reason to appear hardcoded in unrelated software.
